verdict.rationale: Linear's docs explicitly describe automatic routing, labeling, and prioritization of incoming issues from conversations/feedback (linear-docs-62), plus Linear Agent investigating and attempting fixes on new issues before they reach an engineer (linear-docs-45), and configurable agent 'Loops' that can run on a schedule or event to handle recurring triage-like work (linear-docs-36, linear-docs-16). This directly matches the AI-native triage/prioritization story via first-party changelog and marketing docs.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of triage accuracy and no case studies showing this in production use.
